Third-party files shipped with the program (all used offline; nothing is loaded from the internet):

  bootstrap/          Bootstrap 5.3.3 (MIT)                      https://getbootstrap.com/
  bootstrap-icons/    Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3 (MIT)               https://icons.getbootstrap.com/
  qr/qrcode.js        QR Code Generator for JavaScript (MIT)     Kazuhiko Arase, https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
  qr/jsQR.js          jsQR 1.4.0 (Apache 2.0)                    https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
  fonts/              Plus Jakarta Sans (SIL Open Font License)  https://github.com/tokotype/PlusJakartaSans  (see fonts/OFL.txt)

When these folders are missing, Bootstrap and the icons load from cdn.jsdelivr.net instead.
